{{Short description|French mathematician}}
[[File:Sikoravphoto.png|thumb|Jean-Claude Sikorav]]
'''Jean-Claude Sikorav''' (born 21 June 1957) is a French mathematician.  He is professor at  the [[École normale supérieure de Lyon]]. He is specialized in [[symplectic geometry]].<ref>See [http://www.cnrs.fr/fr/recherche/prix/docs/bronze2009/WelschingerJY.pdf here] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120712102006/http://www.cnrs.fr/fr/recherche/prix/docs/bronze2009/WelschingerJY.pdf |date=2012-07-12 }}</ref>

==Main contributions==
Sikorav is known{{According to whom|date=October 2019}} for his proof, joint with [[François Laudenbach]], of the [[Arnold conjecture]] for Lagrangian intersections in cotangent bundles,<ref>Laudenbach, Sikorav, Persistance d'intersection avec la section nulle au cours d'une isotopie hamiltonienne dans un fibre cotangent, [[Inventiones Mathematicae]] 82 (1985), no. 2, 349–357</ref> as well as for introducing [[generating families]] in symplectic topology.

==Selected publications==
Sikorav is one of fifteen members of a group of mathematicians who published the book ''Uniformisation des surfaces de Riemann'' under the [[pseudonym]] of Henri Paul de Saint-Gervais.<ref>{{citation
 | last = de Saint-Gervais | first = Henri Paul
 | isbn = 978-2-84788-233-9
 | mr = 2768303
 | publisher = ENS Éditions, Lyon
 | title = Uniformisation des surfaces de Riemann: Retour sur un théorème centenaire
 | year = 2010}}.</ref>

Sikorav is a Knight of the [[Ordre des Palmes Académiques]].
